SPARKOZ partners with Pacific Floorcare on US robot manufacturing

A new manufacturing partnership accompanies demonstrations of TN-30, handheld LiDAR mapping and a cloud service without recurring subscriptions.

PRWeb / SPARKOZ ↗17 November 2026English editorial summary
Story

Manufacturing closer to customers

SPARKOZ announced a manufacturing partnership with Michigan-based floor-care equipment maker Pacific Floorcare on November 17. The arrangement aims to expand US production of robotic cleaning equipment by combining SPARKOZ automation technology with its partner’s manufacturing capabilities.

Cleaning includes mapping and fleet management

At ISSA on November 17–19, the company is demonstrating TN-30, a compact cleaner for medium-size commercial spaces, alongside handheld 3D LiDAR mapping. Its Robot Cloud offers fleet monitoring, remote management, cleaning reports and software updates without recurring subscription fees, according to the announcement.

Supply-chain benefits are still objectives

Local production is intended to shorten lead times and improve access to parts and service in North America. The release does not disclose investment, production capacity or a manufacturing start date. Faster delivery and lower support friction are objectives, rather than measured results already demonstrated by this partnership.
